title: The Heroine
author: Eaton Stannard Barrett
description: "The Heroine" by Eaton Stannard Barrett is a novel first published in 1813.
longDescription: This satirical work follows Cherry Wilkinson, a novel-obsessed young woman who imagines herself as the heroine of a Gothic romance.

authorInfo.bio: Eaton Stannard Barrett (1786–1820) wrote The Heroine. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
